title: Async Job
description: Any action whose worst-case latency can exceed its manifest latencyBudgetMs MUST be exposed this way instead of as a blocking call (constitution.md, Article 4). Two operations: submit (returns this shape immediately, status='pending') and getStatus(jobId) (returns this shape, current status). Never a bare synchronous call with a long timeout.

jobId.description: Opaque identifier the agent stores and polls with. Must be stable across the job's lifetime.

progress.description: Optional coarse progress signal so an agent can decide whether to keep polling or report back to its own caller.

pollAfterMs.description: Suggested minimum delay before the next getStatus call. Present on pending/running responses. Prevents agents from busy-polling.

result.description: Present only when status is 'succeeded'. Shape matches the wrapped action's outputSchema.

error.description: Present only when status is 'failed'. Shape matches error-envelope.schema.json's error object.
